jobs.title: Director of Business Technology
jobs.description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands\-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co\-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home\-built software, and teach non\-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day\-to\-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign\-in, multi\-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on\-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands\-on, the platforms our home\-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign\-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home\-built tools are business\-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on\-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands\-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI\-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands\-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen\-developer or low\-code programme.
* Hands\-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non\-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100\-to\-500\-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low\-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid\-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid\-sized businesses, ready to go in\-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign\-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid\-sized company.
* Experience in mid\-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co\-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on\-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

jobs.title: Director of Sales
jobs.description:
At Levitt\-Safety, we're in the business of helping people work safely. With 90 years of experience, we bring together trusted expertise, quality products and service solutions to protect people, property and the environment.
  
We're looking for a Director of Sales to lead our national sales organization and drive profitable, sustainable growth. Reporting to the VP \- Sales \& Marketing, you'll lead through our Regional Sales Managers, turning business strategy into action, strengthening customer relationships and building a high\-performing sales team across Canada.
  
If you're a strategic sales leader who knows how to develop people, build strong customer partnerships and turn opportunities into results, we'd like to hear from you.
  
This role is based in our head office in Oakville.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
* Lead the development and execution of a national sales strategy, translating business priorities into clear regional goals, plans and accountability.
* Coach and develop Regional Sales Managers, strengthening leadership capability, sales execution and team performance.
* Drive national revenue and gross margin performance, maintaining a healthy sales pipeline, accurate forecasts and clear performance expectations.
* Build consistency across regions through effective sales practices, territory planning and customer account management.
* Strengthen relationships with key, strategic and national accounts, ensuring the right resources and expertise are brought together to meet customer needs.
* Champion a team\-selling approach by connecting Sales with Service, Market Segment Managers and other internal specialists to deliver complete customer solutions.
* Use Salesforce and business insights to monitor performance, identify opportunities and support informed decisions.
* Partner with Commercial Operations and Service leadership to improve sales effectiveness, customer retention and growth opportunities.
* Build a strong sales leadership pipeline by developing talent, supporting succession planning and creating opportunities for growth.
* Lead change and foster a collaborative, accountable and customer\-focused sales culture.


What You'll Bring
  
* Progressive senior sales leadership experience, ideally leading regional sales teams or other sales leaders.
* A track record of developing and executing sales strategies that deliver profitable growth across multiple regions or territories.
* Strong business and financial acumen, with experience managing revenue, gross margin, forecasting and sales performance.
* Experience with strategic account management, territory planning and complex customer relationships.
* A proven ability to coach, motivate and develop leaders and high\-performing teams.
* Strong CRM experience, preferably Salesforce, with an understanding of how data supports sales effectiveness and decision\-making.
* Excellent communication, influencing, negotiation and relationship\-building skills.
* A collaborative leadership style and the ability to build strong partnerships across different business functions.
* Ability to travel nationally and work occasional extended hours to meet business needs.


Choose the Safe Way, Always
  
Safety is at the heart of everything we do. As a leader, you'll champion a strong safety culture and ensure safe decision\-making is part of how our sales organization operates.
  
You'll follow all company and customer health and safety requirements, including safe driving practices and required safety procedures when visiting customer sites, branches and other locations.
  
  

Why Levitt\-Safety?
  
At Levitt\-Safety, we believe our people are our greatest strength. When you join our team, you'll be part of an established Canadian company with 90 years of experience, a strong reputation and a shared commitment to helping people work safely.
  
  

**Here's what you can look forward to:**  

* Competitive annual base salary of $160,000 \- $190,000, commensurate with skills and experience and aligned with internal equity, plus an annual bonus opportunity.
* Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental and vision coverage to support you and your family's well\-being.
* Company\-matched RRSP program as well as profit\-sharing.
* Opportunities to grow your leadership capabilities and advance your career while helping shape the national sales strategy, develop leaders and make a measurable impact on business growth.
* A collaborative team to work alongside; knowledgeable people who value teamwork, accountability and doing what's right.
* A purpose\-driven organization where safety isn't just what we do; it's what we stand for.


Application \& Hiring Process
  
  

Levitt\-Safety may use AI\-enabled tools to support the screening and assessment of applications.
  
  

All AI\-supported results are reviewed by a member of our recruitment team before any hiring decisions are made.
  
  

We are committed to employment equity and base hiring decisions on qualifications, skills, and ability. We welcome and encourage applications from persons with disabilities, visible minorities, Indigenous Peoples, and individuals from diverse backgrounds, and we recognize that experience comes in many forms.
  
  

If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process, please contact us at talent@levitt\-safety.com. We review applications as they are received and look forward to hearing from you.

This is a hands\-on role for a sales and pipeline analytics professional. The successful candidate is comfortable working directly with data, building reporting and dashboards, and developing analytical or predictive models when they add value. The role also connects Research Services with frontline fundraising. It translates prospect intelligence and analytical signals into clear, prioritized opportunities so fundraisers can focus their time and effort on the prospects with the greatest potential.



The Associate Director, Development Analytics is a key role within the Business Intelligence \& Analytics team. Reporting directly to the Director, Development Analytics, you will provide functional leadership for Development Analytics, serve as the authoritative advisor to Development leadership, and partner across the analytics function: with Data Science \& Engineering to ensure development data is well modelled and accessible, with Research Services to turn prospect intelligence into action, and with Marketing Analytics to build end\-to\-end visibility from donor acquisition through the development pipeline.

**Job Posting: Finance Director**
=================================


Finance \| EastGen \| Guelph, Ontario \| Hybrid

**Reports to:** CEO  

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, eight hours per day, with core hours from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.  

**Work arrangement:** Hybrid, with at least three office days per week  

**Status:** Full\-time, permanent  

**Compensation:** Starting at $110,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year. We compensate our team members based on the experience and knowledge they bring to the role and review salary on an annual basis.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


At EastGen, we are proud to advance the dairy and beef industries through leading genetics, innovative technology, and reproductive solutions. As a Canadian, farmer\-owned organization, we put farmers first and build lasting relationships through respect, integrity, expertise, and reliable service.


Our greatest strength is our people. We invest in a knowledgeable, highly trained team that supports agricultural customers across Ontario and Atlantic Canada.


EastGen is seeking a strategic, collaborative Finance Director to lead our Finance Department and provide financial leadership to the Board and senior management. You will turn complex financial information into insight that shapes business decisions, while protecting the organization through sound financial policies and controls.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Lead the finance team:** Coach and develop a team of four professionals, build positive and collaborative team culture, and enable individual success through goal setting and follow up
* **Develop financial strategy:** Provide strategic financial leadership and advise the CEO and Board of Directors on financial planning, capital structure, and risk management.
* **Hands\-on operations:** Balance working with the team and “rolling up your sleeves” to get into the details. You’ll oversee accounts receivable, accounts payable, general ledger, asset control, cash position, investment portfolio, and short\- and long\-term financing.
* **Drive planning and reporting:** Lead financial planning and budgeting, prepare and present monthly financial statements to CEO and the Board
* **Safeguard controls and compliance:** Ensure effective internal controls, regulatory compliance, insurance relationships, and lead annual external audit.
* **Analyze performance and lead projects:** Analyze trends, identify opportunities for improvement, and participate in special projects to meet business needs.
* **Partner with the business:** Participate on the senior leadership team, work closely with other functional leaders to enable business success and superior customer service.
**What You Bring**
------------------

* **Must have**
	+ An undergraduate degree in Business, Finance, or Accounting, and a Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation.
	+ At least five (5\) years of experience leading a finance department.
	+ Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
	+ Strong aptitude for ERP systems, ideally Microsoft Dynamics/AX.
	+ Proven relationship\-building, collaboration, and communication skills.
	+ Strong critical thinking, analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
	+ Ability to balance big picture strategic thinking with day\-to\-day operational tasks.
* **Nice to have**
	+ Small business and/or not\-for\-profit (NPO) experience.
	+ Experience working in the agriculture industry.
	+ ERP implementation experience.
	+ Experience leveraging Microsoft Co\-Pilot or similar.
**Why Join EastGen?**
---------------------

* **Values\-driven culture** – A farmer\-owned organization built on respect, integrity, and teamwork
* **Strategic influence** – Shape financial strategy alongside the CEO and Board of Directors
* **Career development** – Ongoing learning, training, and growth in role
* **Comprehensive benefits** – Health, dental, vision, health care spending account, and disability coverage
* **Group RRSP matching** – Employer\-matched contributions toward your future
* **Work\-life balance** – Flexible and supportive policies and practices
**Application Process**
-----------------------


We are actively seeking to fill this current vacancy and are looking for a qualified candidate to join us as soon as possible.


Please submit your application on the EastGen website and apply through the "Careers" page. Only applications submitted through our website careers portal will be reviewed.


Applications are reviewed as they are received and only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

EastGen does not use artificial intelligence or automated algorithms to screen, assess, or select applicants. Every application is personally reviewed by our team to ensure your unique experience and potential receives the genuine consideration you deserve.

**Accommodations in hiring:** EastGen is dedicated to creating an inclusive, accessible, and barrier\-free work environment. We welcome requests for accommodations throughout our recruitment process. Please contact careers@eastgen.ca to discuss your unique needs.
